model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_run_lo.name: cesc_identity_run_log
model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_run_lo.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table'
) }}

WITH resolution_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT bill_source_key) AS total_bills_evaluated,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN resolution_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN bill_source_key END) AS resolved_bill_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN resolution_type = 'DETERMINISTIC' AND resolution_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN bill_source_key END) AS deterministic_auto_merge_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN resolution_type = 'PROBABILISTIC' AND resolution_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN bill_source_key END) AS probabilistic_connect_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN resolution_status = 'CANDIDATE_UNDER_REVIEW' THEN bill_source_key END) AS manual_review_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN resolution_status = 'UNRESOLVED' THEN bill_source_key END) AS unresolved_no_candidate_count,

        -- Breakdown by resolution method
        COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_method = 'PHONE_CONSUMER_MATCH' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_phone_consumer_match,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_method = 'PHONE_MATCH_NEW_CONSUMER' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_phone_new_consumer,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_method = 'PHONE_MATCH_CONSUMER_SHARED' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_phone_consumer_shared,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_method = 'CONSUMER_EMAIL_MATCH' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_consumer_email_match,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_method = 'CONSUMER_NAME_PROBABLE' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_consumer_name_probable,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_method = 'NEAR_PHONE_CORROBORATED' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_near_phone_corroborated,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_method = 'EVIDENCE_EVALUATED' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_evidence_evaluated,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN resolution_method = 'UNRESOLVED_NO_CIH_CANDIDATE' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_unresolved_no_candidate
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_identity_resolution') }}
),

candidate_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_candidate_pairs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN has_exact_phone_path THEN 1 END) AS cnt_exact_phone_paths,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN has_near_phone_path THEN 1 END) AS cnt_near_phone_paths,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN has_consumer_path THEN 1 END) AS cnt_consumer_paths
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_identity_candidate_pairs') }}
),

entity_summary AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_resolved_entities
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_entity_nodes') }}
)

SELECT
    '{{ var("run_id") }}' AS run_id,
    '{{ var("bill_period") }}' AS source_bill_period,
    '{{ var("score_version") }}' AS score_version,
    {{ var("threshold_connect") }} AS threshold_connect,
    {{ var("threshold_manual_review") }} AS threshold_manual_review,
    r.total_bills_evaluated,
    c.total_candidate_pairs,
    e.total_resolved_entities,
    r.resolved_bill_count,
    r.deterministic_auto_merge_count,
    r.probabilistic_connect_count,
    r.manual_review_count,
    r.unresolved_no_candidate_count,
    r.cnt_phone_consumer_match,
    r.cnt_phone_new_consumer,
    r.cnt_phone_consumer_shared,
    r.cnt_consumer_email_match,
    r.cnt_consumer_name_probable,
    r.cnt_near_phone_corroborated,
    r.cnt_evidence_evaluated,
    r.cnt_unresolved_no_candidate,
    c.cnt_exact_phone_paths,
    c.cnt_near_phone_paths,
    c.cnt_consumer_paths,
    CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS logged_at
FROM resolution_summary r
CROSS JOIN candidate_summary c
CROSS JOIN entity_summary e

{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    indexes=[

        {'columns': ['email_normalized']},
        {'columns': ['consumer_no']},

    ) AS bill_source_key,
    customer_id,
    bill_ac_month,
    consumer_no,
    consumer_check_digit,
    regional_office,
    NULLIF(TRIM(address_line_one), '') AS bill_name_raw,
    supply_address,
    pin_cd,
    mobile_raw,
    mobile_normalized,
    mobile_valid_flag,
    email_raw,
    email_normalized,
    email_valid_flag,
    net_amount,
    gross_amount,
    due_date,
    bill_date,
    ebill_status,
    _loaded_at,
    _source_file,
    _ingestion_batch_id
FROM source

model.cesc_identity.cesc_cih_lookup_cons.name: cesc_cih_lookup_consumer
model.cesc_identity.cesc_cih_lookup_cons.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    indexes=[
        {'columns': ['consumer_no']},
        {'columns': ['cih_source_row_key']}
    ]
) }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cih_source_row_key,
        consumer_no
    FROM {{ source('staging', 'stg_cesc_cih_consumer_numbers') }}
    WHERE consumer_no IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        consumer_no,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cih_source_row_key) AS consumer_count_for_no
    FROM base
    GROUP BY consumer_no
)

SELECT
    b.cih_source_row_key,
    b.consumer_no,
    c.consumer_count_for_no
FROM base b
JOIN counts c ON b.consumer_no = c.consumer_no

model.cesc_identity.cesc_cih_lookup_emai.name: cesc_cih_lookup_email
model.cesc_identity.cesc_cih_lookup_emai.raw_code:
{{ config(

    indexes=[

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cih_source_row_key,
        email_normalized
    FROM {{ source('staging', 'stg_cesc_cih') }}
    WHERE email_normalized IS NOT NULL
      AND email_valid_flag = TRUE
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        email_normalized,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cih_source_row_key) AS email_cih_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY email_normalized
)

    b.email_normalized,
    c.email_cih_count
FROM base b
JOIN counts c ON b.email_normalized = c.email_normalized

model.cesc_identity.cesc_cih_lookup_phon.name: cesc_cih_lookup_phone

model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_candid.name: cesc_identity_candidate_pairs
model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_candid.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    indexes=[
        {'columns': ['bill_source_key']},
        {'columns': ['cih_source_row_key']},
        {'columns': ['bill_source_key', 'cih_source_row_key'], 'unique': true}
    ]
) }}

WITH bill_spine AS (
    SELECT
        bill_source_key,
        consumer_no,
        mobile_normalized,
        mobile_valid_flag
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_bill_spine') }}
),

cih_phone AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cih_source_row_key,
        mobile_normalized,
        phone_block_1,
        phone_block_2,
        phone_block_3,
        phone_block_4,
        phone_block_5
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_cih_lookup_phone') }}
),

cih_consumer AS (
    SELECT cih_source_row_key, consumer_no
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_cih_lookup_consumer') }}
),

-- 1. Exact phone match (Branch A entry) -- UNCHANGED
pairs_phone_exact AS (
    SELECT
        b.bill_source_key,
        p.cih_source_row_key,
        TRUE AS has_exact_phone_path,
        FALSE AS has_near_phone_path,
        0 AS phone_digit_distance,
        NULL::INT AS phone_differing_position,
        FALSE AS has_consumer_path
    FROM bill_spine b
    JOIN cih_phone p ON b.mobile_normalized = p.mobile_normalized
    WHERE b.mobile_valid_flag = TRUE
),

-- 2. Exact consumer match (Branch B entry / account lookup) -- UNCHANGED
pairs_consumer AS (
    SELECT
        b.bill_source_key,
        c.cih_source_row_key,
        FALSE AS has_exact_phone_path,
        FALSE AS has_near_phone_path,
        NULL::INT AS phone_digit_distance,
        NULL::INT AS phone_differing_position,
        TRUE AS has_consumer_path
    FROM bill_spine b
    JOIN cih_consumer c ON b.consumer_no = c.consumer_no
),

-- 3. Combine exact-match candidate paths only.
-- Near-phone / Hamming-distance matching has been removed.
combined_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        bill_source_key,
        cih_source_row_key,
        has_exact_phone_path,
        has_near_phone_path,
        phone_digit_distance,
        phone_differing_position,
        has_consumer_path
    FROM pairs_phone_exact

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        bill_source_key,
        cih_source_row_key,
        has_exact_phone_path,
        has_near_phone_path,
        phone_digit_distance,
        phone_differing_position,
        has_consumer_path
    FROM pairs_consumer
),

-- Collapse multiple exact-match paths for the same bill/CIH pair.
final_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        bill_source_key,
        cih_source_row_key,
        BOOL_OR(has_exact_phone_path) AS has_exact_phone_path,
        BOOL_OR(has_near_phone_path) AS has_near_phone_path,
        MIN(phone_digit_distance) AS phone_digit_distance,
        MIN(phone_differing_position) FILTER (
            WHERE phone_differing_position IS NOT NULL
        ) AS phone_differing_position,
        BOOL_OR(has_consumer_path) AS has_consumer_path
    FROM combined_candidates
    GROUP BY
        bill_source_key,
        cih_source_row_key
)

SELECT
    bill_source_key,
    cih_source_row_key,
    has_exact_phone_path,
    has_near_phone_path,
    phone_digit_distance,
    phone_differing_position,
    has_consumer_path
FROM final_candidates

model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_eviden.name: cesc_identity_evidence
model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_eviden.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    indexes=[
        {'columns': ['bill_source_key']},
        {'columns': ['cih_source_row_key']},
        {'columns': ['bill_source_key', 'cih_source_row_key'], 'unique': true}
    ]
) }}

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_identity_candidate_pairs') }}
),

bills AS (
    SELECT
        bill_source_key,
        consumer_no,
        mobile_normalized,
        mobile_valid_flag,
        email_normalized,
        email_valid_flag,
        bill_name_raw,
        supply_address,
        pin_cd,
        CONCAT_WS(
            ' ',
            NULLIF(TRIM(supply_address), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(pin_cd), '')
        ) AS bill_address_concat
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_bill_spine') }}
),

cih AS (
    SELECT
        cih_source_row_key,
        name_normalized AS cih_name_normalized,
        email_normalized AS cih_email_normalized,
        mobile_normalized AS cih_mobile_normalized,
        CONCAT_WS(
            ' ',
            NULLIF(TRIM(house_no), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(floor), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(street), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(city), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(pincode), '')
        ) AS cih_address_concat
    FROM {{ source('staging', 'stg_cesc_cih') }}
),

cih_email_counts AS (
    SELECT
        email_normalized,
        MAX(email_cih_count) AS email_cih_count
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_cih_lookup_email') }}
    GROUP BY email_normalized
)

SELECT
    cand.bill_source_key,
    cand.cih_source_row_key,

    CASE
        WHEN cand.has_exact_phone_path
             AND cand.has_consumer_path
            THEN 'PHONE_CONSUMER'
        WHEN cand.has_exact_phone_path
            THEN 'PHONE'
        WHEN cand.has_consumer_path
            THEN 'CONSUMER'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS candidate_generation_method,

    -- Phone evidence
    b.mobile_valid_flag AS phone_available,
    cand.has_exact_phone_path,
    cand.has_near_phone_path,
    cand.phone_digit_distance,
    cand.phone_differing_position,

    CASE
        WHEN cand.has_exact_phone_path THEN 'EXACT'
        WHEN cand.has_near_phone_path
             AND cand.phone_differing_position >= 6
            THEN 'NEAR_POS_6_10'
        WHEN cand.has_near_phone_path
             AND cand.phone_differing_position < 6
            THEN 'NEAR_POS_1_5'
        ELSE 'NONE'
    END AS phone_match_type,

    CASE
        WHEN cand.has_exact_phone_path THEN 45.00
        WHEN cand.has_near_phone_path
             AND cand.phone_differing_position >= 6
            THEN 35.00
        WHEN cand.has_near_phone_path
             AND cand.phone_differing_position < 6
            THEN 25.00
        ELSE 0.00
    END AS phone_evidence_points,

    -- Consumer evidence
    (b.consumer_no IS NOT NULL) AS consumer_available,

    cand.has_consumer_path AS consumer_match,

    CASE
        WHEN cand.has_consumer_path THEN 25.00
        ELSE 0.00
    END AS consumer_evidence_points,

    -- Email evidence
    b.email_valid_flag AS email_available,

    (
        b.email_valid_flag = TRUE
        AND b.email_normalized = c.cih_email_normalized
    ) AS email_match,

    ec.email_cih_count,

    CASE
        WHEN b.email_valid_flag = TRUE
         AND b.email_normalized = c.cih_email_normalized
            THEN 15.00
        ELSE 0.00
    END AS email_evidence_points,

    -- Name similarity
    (
        NOT cand.has_exact_phone_path
        AND b.bill_name_raw IS NOT NULL
        AND c.cih_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
    ) AS name_available,

    b.bill_name_raw,
    c.cih_name_normalized,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT cand.has_exact_phone_path
         AND b.bill_name_raw IS NOT NULL
         AND c.cih_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
            THEN ROUND(
                similarity(
                    b.bill_name_raw,
                    c.cih_name_normalized
                )::NUMERIC,
                4
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS name_similarity_score,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT cand.has_exact_phone_path
         AND b.bill_name_raw IS NOT NULL
         AND c.cih_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
            THEN ROUND(
                (
                    similarity(
                        b.bill_name_raw,
                        c.cih_name_normalized
                    ) * 10.0
                )::NUMERIC,
                2
            )
        ELSE 0.00
    END AS name_evidence_points,

    -- Address similarity
    (
        NOT cand.has_exact_phone_path
        AND NULLIF(b.bill_address_concat, '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(c.cih_address_concat, '') IS NOT NULL
    ) AS address_available,

    b.bill_address_concat,
    c.cih_address_concat,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT cand.has_exact_phone_path
         AND NULLIF(b.bill_address_concat, '') IS NOT NULL
         AND NULLIF(c.cih_address_concat, '') IS NOT NULL
            THEN ROUND(
                similarity(
                    b.bill_address_concat,
                    c.cih_address_concat
                )::NUMERIC,
                4
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS address_similarity_score,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT cand.has_exact_phone_path
         AND NULLIF(b.bill_address_concat, '') IS NOT NULL
         AND NULLIF(c.cih_address_concat, '') IS NOT NULL
            THEN ROUND(
                (
                    similarity(
                        b.bill_address_concat,
                        c.cih_address_concat
                    ) * 5.0
                )::NUMERIC,
                2
            )
        ELSE 0.00
    END AS address_evidence_points,

    -- Deferred householding / surname tokens
    REVERSE(
        SPLIT_PART(
            REVERSE(TRIM(b.bill_name_raw)),
            ' ',
            1
        )
    ) AS bill_last_name_token,

    REVERSE(
        SPLIT_PART(
            REVERSE(TRIM(c.cih_name_normalized)),
            ' ',
            1
        )
    ) AS cih_last_name_token,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT cand.has_exact_phone_path
         AND b.bill_name_raw IS NOT NULL
         AND c.cih_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
         AND LOWER(
                REVERSE(
                    SPLIT_PART(
                        REVERSE(TRIM(b.bill_name_raw)),
                        ' ',
                        1
                    )
                )
             ) =
             LOWER(
                REVERSE(
                    SPLIT_PART(
                        REVERSE(TRIM(c.cih_name_normalized)),
                        ' ',
                        1
                    )
                )
             )
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS last_name_exact_match,

    CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS evaluated_at

FROM candidates cand

JOIN bills b
    ON cand.bill_source_key = b.bill_source_key

JOIN cih c
    ON cand.cih_source_row_key = c.cih_source_row_key

LEFT JOIN cih_email_counts ec
    ON b.email_normalized = ec.email_normalized

model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_resolu.name: cesc_identity_resolution
model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_resolu.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    indexes=[
        {'columns': ['bill_source_key']},
        {'columns': ['resolved_cih_source_row_key']},
        {'columns': ['resolution_status']},
        {'columns': ['confidence_band']}
    ]
) }}

WITH all_bills AS (
    SELECT
        bill_source_key
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_bill_spine') }}
),

scored_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        bill_source_key,
        cih_source_row_key,
        resolution_method,
        score_type,
        confidence_score,
        normalized_score,
        raw_score,
        applicable_max_score,
        confidence_band,
        score_version,
        phone_match_type,
        phone_evidence_points,
        consumer_match,
        consumer_evidence_points,
        email_match,
        email_evidence_points,
        email_cih_count,
        name_similarity_score,
        name_evidence_points,
        address_similarity_score,
        address_evidence_points,
        last_name_exact_match,
        scored_at
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_identity_scored_candidates') }}
),

ranked_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.bill_source_key
        ) AS total_candidate_count,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.bill_source_key
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN s.score_type = 'DETERMINISTIC' THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END,
                s.normalized_score DESC,
                s.raw_score DESC,
                s.cih_source_row_key ASC
        ) AS candidate_rank

    FROM scored_candidates s
),

confirmed_links AS (
    SELECT
        rc.bill_source_key,
        rc.cih_source_row_key AS resolved_cih_source_row_key,
        (rc.candidate_rank = 1) AS is_primary_resolution,
        rc.resolution_method,
        'RESOLVED' AS resolution_status,
        rc.score_type AS resolution_type,
        rc.confidence_score,
        rc.normalized_score,
        rc.raw_score,
        rc.applicable_max_score,
        rc.confidence_band,
        rc.score_type,
        rc.score_version,
        rc.candidate_rank,
        rc.total_candidate_count,
        rc.phone_match_type,
        rc.phone_evidence_points,
        rc.consumer_match,
        rc.consumer_evidence_points,
        rc.email_match,
        rc.email_evidence_points,
        rc.email_cih_count,
        rc.name_similarity_score,
        rc.name_evidence_points,
        rc.address_similarity_score,
        rc.address_evidence_points,
        rc.last_name_exact_match,
        FALSE AS manual_review_required,
        NULL::TEXT AS review_reason,
        rc.scored_at AS resolved_at
    FROM ranked_candidates rc
    WHERE rc.confidence_band IN ('AUTO_MERGE', 'CONNECT')
),

unconfirmed_candidates_bills AS (
    SELECT
        rc.bill_source_key,
        rc.cih_source_row_key AS resolved_cih_source_row_key,
        (rc.candidate_rank = 1) AS is_primary_resolution,
        rc.resolution_method,
        'CANDIDATE_UNDER_REVIEW' AS resolution_status,
        'MANUAL_REVIEW' AS resolution_type,
        rc.confidence_score,
        rc.normalized_score,
        rc.raw_score,
        rc.applicable_max_score,
        rc.confidence_band,
        rc.score_type,
        rc.score_version,
        rc.candidate_rank,
        rc.total_candidate_count,
        rc.phone_match_type,
        rc.phone_evidence_points,
        rc.consumer_match,
        rc.consumer_evidence_points,
        rc.email_match,
        rc.email_evidence_points,
        rc.email_cih_count,
        rc.name_similarity_score,
        rc.name_evidence_points,
        rc.address_similarity_score,
        rc.address_evidence_points,
        rc.last_name_exact_match,
        TRUE AS manual_review_required,
        'Confidence score below threshold (< 70)' AS review_reason,
        rc.scored_at AS resolved_at
    FROM ranked_candidates rc
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM confirmed_links cl
        WHERE cl.bill_source_key = rc.bill_source_key
    )
),

bills_without_any_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.bill_source_key,
        NULL::TEXT AS resolved_cih_source_row_key,
        TRUE AS is_primary_resolution,
        'UNRESOLVED_NO_CIH_CANDIDATE' AS resolution_method,
        'UNRESOLVED' AS resolution_status,
        'UNRESOLVED' AS resolution_type,
        0.00 AS confidence_score,
        0.00 AS normalized_score,
        0.00 AS raw_score,
        0.00 AS applicable_max_score,
        'UNRESOLVED' AS confidence_band,
        'NONE' AS score_type,
        '{{ var("score_version") }}' AS score_version,
        1 AS candidate_rank,
        0 AS total_candidate_count,
        'NONE' AS phone_match_type,
        0.00 AS phone_evidence_points,
        FALSE AS consumer_match,
        0.00 AS consumer_evidence_points,
        FALSE AS email_match,
        0.00 AS email_evidence_points,
        NULL::INT AS email_cih_count,
        NULL::NUMERIC(5,4) AS name_similarity_score,
        0.00 AS name_evidence_points,
        NULL::NUMERIC(5,4) AS address_similarity_score,
        0.00 AS address_evidence_points,
        FALSE AS last_name_exact_match,
        FALSE AS manual_review_required,
        'No CIH candidate identified across phone, email, or consumer number' AS review_reason,
        CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS resolved_at
    FROM all_bills b
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM scored_candidates sc
        WHERE sc.bill_source_key = b.bill_source_key
    )
)

SELECT *
FROM confirmed_links

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM unconfirmed_candidates_bills

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM bills_without_any_candidates

model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_review.name: cesc_identity_review_queue
model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_review.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    indexes=[
        {'columns': ['bill_source_key']},
        {'columns': ['review_status']}
    ]
) }}

WITH candidates_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.bill_source_key
            ORDER BY s.normalized_score DESC, s.raw_score DESC, s.cih_source_row_key ASC
        ) AS rank_num
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_identity_scored_candidates') }} s
),

top_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        bill_source_key,
        cih_source_row_key AS top_candidate_key,
        normalized_score AS top_candidate_score,
        resolution_method AS top_resolution_method,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'phone_match_type', phone_match_type,
            'phone_points', phone_evidence_points,
            'consumer_match', consumer_match,
            'consumer_points', consumer_evidence_points,
            'email_match', email_match,
            'email_points', email_evidence_points,
            'email_cih_count', email_cih_count,
            'name_similarity', name_similarity_score,
            'name_points', name_evidence_points,
            'address_similarity', address_similarity_score,
            'address_points', address_evidence_points,
            'raw_score', raw_score,
            'applicable_max', applicable_max_score,
            'normalized_score', normalized_score
        ) AS top_evidence_summary
    FROM candidates_ranked
    WHERE rank_num = 1
),

second_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        bill_source_key,
        cih_source_row_key AS second_candidate_key,
        normalized_score AS second_candidate_score
    FROM candidates_ranked
    WHERE rank_num = 2
),

review_bills AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        bill_source_key,
        total_candidate_count,
        review_reason
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_identity_resolution') }}
    WHERE manual_review_required = TRUE
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS review_id,
    rb.bill_source_key,
    rb.total_candidate_count,
    tc.top_candidate_key,
    tc.top_candidate_score,
    sc.second_candidate_key,
    sc.second_candidate_score,
    ROUND((tc.top_candidate_score - COALESCE(sc.second_candidate_score, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS score_gap,
    tc.top_resolution_method AS resolution_method,
    rb.review_reason,
    tc.top_evidence_summary AS evidence_summary,
    'PENDING' AS review_status,
    NULL::TEXT AS reviewed_by,
    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS reviewed_at,
    CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at
FROM review_bills rb
JOIN top_candidates tc ON rb.bill_source_key = tc.bill_source_key
LEFT JOIN second_candidates sc ON rb.bill_source_key = sc.bill_source_key

model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_scored.name: cesc_identity_scored_candidates
model.cesc_identity.cesc_identity_scored.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    indexes=[
        {'columns': ['bill_source_key']},
        {'columns': ['cih_source_row_key']},
        {'columns': ['bill_source_key', 'cih_source_row_key'], 'unique': true},
        {'columns': ['confidence_band']}
    ]
) }}

WITH evidence AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_identity_evidence') }}
),

global_consumer_existence AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT consumer_no
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_cih_lookup_consumer') }}
),

bills AS (
    SELECT bill_source_key, consumer_no
    FROM {{ ref('cesc_bill_spine') }}
),

scored AS (
    SELECT
        e.bill_source_key,
        e.cih_source_row_key,
        e.candidate_generation_method,
        e.phone_match_type,
        e.phone_evidence_points,
        e.phone_digit_distance,
        e.phone_differing_position,
        e.consumer_match,
        e.consumer_evidence_points,
        e.email_match,
        e.email_evidence_points,
        e.email_cih_count,
        e.name_similarity_score,
        e.name_evidence_points,
        e.address_similarity_score,
        e.address_evidence_points,
        e.last_name_exact_match,

        -- Calculate applicable maximum points based on available evidence
        (
            CASE WHEN e.phone_available THEN 45.00 ELSE 0.00 END +
            CASE WHEN e.consumer_available THEN 25.00 ELSE 0.00 END +
            CASE WHEN e.email_available THEN 15.00 ELSE 0.00 END +
            CASE WHEN e.name_available THEN 10.00 ELSE 0.00 END +
            CASE WHEN e.address_available THEN 5.00 ELSE 0.00 END
        ) AS applicable_max_score,

        -- Raw sum of earned points
        (
            e.phone_evidence_points +
            e.consumer_evidence_points +
            e.email_evidence_points +
            e.name_evidence_points +
            e.address_evidence_points
        ) AS raw_score,

        -- Check if consumer number exists anywhere in CIH
        (gce.consumer_no IS NOT NULL) AS consumer_exists_globally_in_cih

    FROM evidence e
    JOIN bills b ON e.bill_source_key = b.bill_source_key
    LEFT JOIN global_consumer_existence gce ON b.consumer_no = gce.consumer_no
)

SELECT
    bill_source_key,
    cih_source_row_key,
    candidate_generation_method,
    phone_match_type,
    phone_evidence_points,
    phone_digit_distance,
    phone_differing_position,
    consumer_match,
    consumer_evidence_points,
    email_match,
    email_evidence_points,
    email_cih_count,
    name_similarity_score,
    name_evidence_points,
    address_similarity_score,
    address_evidence_points,
    last_name_exact_match,
    raw_score,
    applicable_max_score,

    -- Normalized score (0 - 100)
    CASE
        WHEN applicable_max_score > 0
        THEN ROUND((raw_score / applicable_max_score) * 100.0, 2)
        ELSE 0.00
    END AS normalized_score,

    -- Deterministic precedence & method assignment
    CASE
        -- Rule D1: Phone Exact + Consumer history match
        WHEN phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = TRUE
        THEN 'PHONE_CONSUMER_MATCH'

        -- Rule D2: Phone Exact + Consumer brand new to system
        WHEN phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = FALSE AND consumer_exists_globally_in_cih = FALSE
        THEN 'PHONE_MATCH_NEW_CONSUMER'

        -- Flowchart branch: Phone exact, consumer present on a different CIH
        WHEN phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = FALSE AND consumer_exists_globally_in_cih = TRUE
        THEN 'PHONE_MATCH_CONSUMER_SHARED'

        -- Flowchart branch: Consumer match + Email match (phone missing/different)
        WHEN consumer_match = TRUE AND email_match = TRUE
        THEN 'CONSUMER_EMAIL_MATCH'

        -- Flowchart branch: Consumer match + Name similarity >= 0.70
        WHEN consumer_match = TRUE AND COALESCE(name_similarity_score, 0) >= 0.70
        THEN 'CONSUMER_NAME_PROBABLE'

        -- Near-phone match
        WHEN phone_match_type IN ('NEAR_POS_6_10', 'NEAR_POS_1_5')
        THEN 'NEAR_PHONE_CORROBORATED'

        ELSE 'EVIDENCE_EVALUATED'
    END AS resolution_method,

    CASE
        WHEN (phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = TRUE)
          OR (phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = FALSE AND consumer_exists_globally_in_cih = FALSE)
        THEN 'DETERMINISTIC'
        ELSE 'PROBABILISTIC'
    END AS score_type,

    '{{ var("score_version") }}' AS score_version,

    -- Confidence score
    CASE
        WHEN (phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = TRUE)
          OR (phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = FALSE AND consumer_exists_globally_in_cih = FALSE)
        THEN 100.00
        ELSE (
            CASE
                WHEN applicable_max_score > 0
                THEN ROUND((raw_score / applicable_max_score) * 100.0, 2)
                ELSE 0.00
            END
        )
    END AS confidence_score,

    -- Decision bands: >= 70 CONNECT, < 70 MANUAL_REVIEW
    CASE
        WHEN (phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = TRUE)
          OR (phone_match_type = 'EXACT' AND consumer_match = FALSE AND consumer_exists_globally_in_cih = FALSE)
        THEN 'AUTO_MERGE'
        WHEN (
            CASE
                WHEN applicable_max_score > 0
                THEN ROUND((raw_score / applicable_max_score) * 100.0, 2)
                ELSE 0.00
            END
        ) >= {{ var("threshold_connect") }}
        THEN 'CONNECT'
        ELSE 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
    END AS confidence_band,

    CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS scored_at
FROM scored

{#
  cesc_customer_360  (GOLD, silver_gold)
  Grain: exactly one row per cesc_entity_id (spine = cesc_entity_nodes; every other input is
         pre-aggregated / de-duplicated to one row per entity or per key BEFORE it is joined).
  Contract: docs/reference/CESC_UNIFY360_updated_for_Antigravity.md (125 attributes, all present as columns).
  Attributes without an available source / approved definition are typed NULL columns (never defaulted).

  PROVENANCE OF COLUMNS (each output column below sits in exactly one of these groups):
    (A) ENTITY-MONTH AGGREGATES of the latest billing month: sums over ALL resolved bills of that month
        (amounts, monthly_consumption) - NOT a raw source-record value when latest_month_bills_count > 1.
    (B) PRIMARY / LATEST SOURCE-RECORD ATTRIBUTES: copied from the latest month's primary bill
        (latest bill_date, then largest net_amount) - includes average_consumption (AVG_UNIT) and load_kw.
    (C) CANONICAL / CIH ATTRIBUTES: cesc_entity_nodes canonical fields and the entity's primary CIH row.
    (D) LIFETIME ATTRIBUTES: stg_cesc_lifetime, reached via the primary CIH row's r1_source_ref
        (a source reference only; never an identity key, never a grain, never used to dedupe entities).
        R1 is joined ONLY when it maps to exactly one cesc_entity_id (r1_map below, counted over the primary
        CIH rows of all entities). If an R1 is shared by more than one entity the association is ambiguous:
        every lifetime attribute of every such entity is NULL - no entity is chosen. r1_entity_count exposes
        this (>1 = ambiguous); tests/assert_cesc_r1_single_entity.sql lists the ambiguous R1s.
        Within one R1, duplicate source loads of the lifetime row collapse to the latest _loaded_at.
    (E) DERIVED FROM HISTORY: computed from cesc_customer_monthly (windows are the entity's own latest N
        billing months present in the data - nothing is anchored to a fixed month).
    (F) UNSUPPORTED / UNAPPROVED: typed NULL columns.

  WINDOWS (3M/6M/12M, volatility, preferred payment method, trends): "latest N billing months PRESENT in the
  entity's monthly history" (month_rank by month_start). Months are NOT required to be calendar-consecutive and
  missing months are never invented, so a window can span more than N calendar months. consumption_months_Nm
  states how many months with a value fed each average; a window is full only when it equals N.

  Optional vars (defaults keep every unapproved definition NULL):
    cesc_require_full_window        false : 3M/6M/12M use months actually available (see *_months columns);
                                            true : NULL unless a full N months exist
    cesc_bill_amount_basis          'net_amount' : basis for effective cost per unit (contract only says
                                            "selected bill amount"; this is a working choice, not an approval)
    cesc_bill_value_approved_basis  none : set to 'net_amount' / 'gross_amount' ONLY once approved;
                                            until then lifetime_bill_value and annual_billed_value are NULL
    cesc_annual_year                none : pin a calendar year. If unset, annual_* use each entity's latest bill-month
                                            calendar year as a WORKING DEFAULT - the contract does not define
                                            "the defined year" (see annual_year_source / annual_months_available)
    cesc_persistent_arrear_n        none : N for persistent arrears
    cesc_persistent_arrear_operator none : '>' or '>='. The specification available here does not fix the operator,
                                            so persistent_arrear_flag is NULL unless BOTH N and operator are set
    cesc_trend_window_months  +  cesc_trend_stable_tolerance   none / none :
                                            the contract gives neither the trend window nor a STABLE rule, so
                                            arrears_trend / consumption_trend / billing_trend are NULL unless BOTH
                                            are explicitly configured. STABLE = |slope per month| <= tolerance.
#}
{{ config(

    schema='silver_gold',

{% set basis        = var('cesc_bill_amount_basis', 'net_amount') %}

{% set annual_yr    = var('cesc_annual_year', none) %}
{% set persist_n    = var('cesc_persistent_arrear_n', none) %}

{% set trend_window = var('cesc_trend_window_months', none) %}
{% set trend_tol    = var('cesc_trend_stable_tolerance', none) %}
{% set trend_on     = (trend_window is not none and trend_tol is not none) %}

{% if basis not in ['net_amount', 'gross_amount'] %}

{% endif %}
{% if persist_op is not none and persist_op not in ['>', '>='] %}

{% if approved is not none and approved not in ['net_amount', 'gross_amount'] %}

with nodes as (
    select
        n.cesc_entity_id::text as cesc_entity_id,
        n.primary_cih_source_row_key,
        n.entity_type,
        n.canonical_name,
        n.canonical_mobile,
        n.canonical_email,
        n.canonical_pincode,
        n.first_seen_at,
        n.last_updated_at
    from {{ ref('cesc_entity_nodes') }} n
),

cih as (
    select * from (
        select
            c.cih_source_row_key,
            c.r1_source_ref,
            c.name_normalized,
            c.house_no,
            c.floor,
            c.street,
            c.city,
            c.pincode,
            c.email_normalized,
            c.mobile_normalized,
            c.dnd_raw,
            c.is_mobile_normalized,
            row_number() over (
                partition by c.cih_source_row_key
                order by c._loaded_at desc nulls last
            ) as rn
        FROM {{ source('staging', 'stg_cesc_cih') }} c
        where c.cih_source_row_key in (select primary_cih_source_row_key from nodes)
    ) x
    where x.rn = 1
),

-- how many distinct canonical entities reach each R1 (through their primary CIH row). R1 is auxiliary only.
r1_map as (
    select
        c.r1_source_ref,
        count(distinct n.cesc_entity_id) as r1_entity_count
    from nodes n
    inner join cih c
        on c.cih_source_row_key = n.primary_cih_source_row_key
    where c.r1_source_ref is not null
    group by c.r1_source_ref
),

-- lifetime rows are eligible only for an R1 that maps to exactly one entity; ambiguous R1s stay unmatched (NULL)
lifetime as (
    select * from (
        select
            l.r1_source_ref,
            l.first_bill_date,
            l.last_bill_date,
            l.tenure,
            l.bill_count,
            l.lifetime_spend,
            l.recency_days,
            row_number() over (
                partition by l.r1_source_ref
                order by l._loaded_at desc nulls last, l.last_bill_date desc nulls last
            ) as rn
        FROM {{ source('staging', 'stg_cesc_lifetime') }} l
        where l.r1_source_ref in (select r1_source_ref from r1_map where r1_entity_count = 1)
    ) x
    where x.rn = 1
),

ranked as (
    select
        m.*,
        row_number() over (
            partition by m.cesc_entity_id
            order by m.month_start desc nulls last, m.bill_ac_month::text desc
        ) as month_rank,
        {% if annual_yr is not none %}{{ annual_yr | int }}{% else %}extract(year from max(m.month_start) over (partition by m.cesc_entity_id))::int{% endif %} as annual_year_anchor
    from {{ ref('cesc_customer_monthly') }} m
),

latest as (
    select * from ranked where month_rank = 1
),

agg as (
    select
        cesc_entity_id,
        count(*) filter (where month_start is not null)                          as billed_months_available,
        min(month_start)                                                         as first_billed_month,
        max(month_start)                                                         as latest_billed_month,
        {% for n in [3, 6, 12] %}
        {% set w = "month_start is not null and month_rank <= " ~ n %}
        count(total_unit) filter (where {{ w }})                                 as consumption_months_{{ n }}m,
        {% if strict %}
        case when count(total_unit) filter (where {{ w }}) = {{ n }}
             then avg(total_unit) filter (where {{ w }}) end                     as avg_consumption_{{ n }}m,
        {% else %}
        avg(total_unit) filter (where {{ w }})                                   as avg_consumption_{{ n }}m,
        {% endif %}
        {% endfor %}
        -- contract: stddev(consumption) / mean(consumption); period not specified -> 12-month window
        -- (longest window the contract defines), sample standard deviation; needs >= 2 months
        stddev_samp(total_unit) filter (where {{ w12 }})
            / nullif(avg(total_unit) filter (where {{ w12 }}), 0)                as consumption_volatility,
        {% if trend_on %}
        {% set wt = "month_start is not null and month_rank <= " ~ (trend_window | int) %}
        regr_slope(total_unit::double precision, month_seq::double precision)
            filter (where {{ wt }})                                              as consumption_slope,
        regr_slope(arrear_amount::double precision, month_seq::double precision)
            filter (where {{ wt }})                                              as arrear_slope,
        regr_slope({{ basis }}::double precision, month_seq::double precision)
            filter (where {{ wt }})                                              as billing_slope,
        {% else %}
        cast(null as double precision)                                           as consumption_slope,
        cast(null as double precision)                                           as arrear_slope,
        cast(null as double precision)                                           as billing_slope,
        {% endif %}
        {% if approved is not none %}
        sum({{ approved }})                                                      as lifetime_bill_value,
        sum({{ approved }}) filter (
            where month_start is not null
              and extract(year from month_start)::int = annual_year_anchor)      as annual_billed_value,
        {% else %}
        cast(null as numeric)                                                    as lifetime_bill_value,
        cast(null as numeric)                                                    as annual_billed_value,
        {% endif %}
        max(annual_year_anchor)                                                  as annual_year,
        count(*) filter (
            where month_start is not null
              and extract(year from month_start)::int = annual_year_anchor)      as annual_months_available,
        sum(total_unit) filter (
            where month_start is not null
              and extract(year from month_start)::int = annual_year_anchor)      as annual_consumption
    from ranked
    group by cesc_entity_id
),

pm_counts as (
    select cesc_entity_id, payment_method, count(*) as c
    from ranked
    where {{ w12 }} and payment_method is not null
    group by cesc_entity_id, payment_method
),

pm_ranked as (
    select
        cesc_entity_id,
        payment_method,
        rank() over (partition by cesc_entity_id order by c desc) as rk
    from pm_counts
),

pm_pref as (
    select
        cesc_entity_id,
        case when count(*) filter (where rk = 1) > 1 then 'MIXED'
             else max(payment_method) filter (where rk = 1) end    as preferred_payment_method
    from pm_ranked
    group by cesc_entity_id
)

select
    -- ══ identity / lineage: cesc_entity_id is the ONLY UNIFY360 identity key ══
    n.cesc_entity_id,
    n.entity_type,
    n.primary_cih_source_row_key,
    c.r1_source_ref,                                                 -- source reference only
    rm.r1_entity_count,                                              -- >1 = ambiguous R1: lifetime attributes NULL
    n.first_seen_at                                                  as entity_first_seen_at,
    n.last_updated_at                                                as entity_last_updated_at,

    -- ══ (B) primary / latest source-record attributes (one real bill; customer_id is a source ref, not a key) ══
    lm.customer_id,
    lm.consumer_no,
    lm.check_digit,
    lm.consumer_type,
    lm.consumer_status_code,
    lm.consumer_account_status,
    lm.public_body_status_code                                       as public_body_status,
    lm.regional_office,
    lm.supply_address,

    lm.address_line_six,
    lm.road_code,
    lm.premises_no,

    lm.voltage_status,

    coalesce(lm.pin_cd::text, n.canonical_pincode::text, c.pincode::text) as pincode,

    -- ══ (A) entity-month aggregates for the latest billing month (sum over all resolved bills that month) ══
    lm.bills_in_month                                                as latest_month_bills_count,
    lm.consumer_numbers_in_month                                     as latest_month_consumer_numbers,
    lm.net_amount,
    lm.gross_amount,
    lm.rebate_amount,
    lm.arrear_amount,
    lm.adjustment_amount,
    lm.govt_duty,
    lm.meter_rent_amount,
    lm.security_deposit_amount,
    lm.energy_charges_amount,
    lm.fixed_demand_charges,
    lm.monthly_variable_cost_adjustment,
    lm.fppas_amount,
    lm.advance_payment_adjustment,
    lm.total_unit                                                    as monthly_consumption,

    -- ══ (C) canonical / CIH attributes ══
    coalesce(c.name_normalized, n.canonical_name)                    as customer_name,
    c.city,
    c.house_no                                                       as cih_house_no,      -- CIH address structure differs from the

    c.street                                                         as cih_street,
    c.dnd_raw                                                        as dnd,
    c.is_mobile_normalized                                           as mobile_capable,

    -- ══ (D) lifetime attributes ══
    lf.first_bill_date,
    lf.last_bill_date,
    lf.tenure                                                        as tenure_days,
    lf.tenure::numeric / 30.0                                        as tenure_months,     -- contract: TENURE / 30 (approx.)
    lf.bill_count,
    lf.lifetime_spend,
    lf.recency_days,

    -- ══ (E) derived from the latest month's aggregates (like-with-like inputs) ══
    lm.outstanding_burden_ratio,

    lm.arrear_recovery_rate,
    lm.effective_bill_cost_per_unit,

    -- ══ (E) derived from history ══
    a.avg_consumption_3m,
    a.avg_consumption_6m,
    a.avg_consumption_12m,
    a.consumption_months_3m,

    case when a.consumption_slope is null then null

         when a.consumption_slope > 0 then 'INCREASING'

            c.mobile_normalized,
            c.dnd_raw,
            c.is_mobile_normalized,
            row_number() over (
                partition by c.cih_source_row_key
                order by c._loaded_at desc nulls last
            ) as rn
        FROM "cdp_meta"."staging"."stg_cesc_cih" c
        where c.cih_source_row_key in (select primary_cih_source_row_key from nodes)
    ) x
    where x.rn = 1
),

-- how many distinct canonical entities reach each R1 (through their primary CIH row). R1 is auxiliary only.
r1_map as (
    select
        c.r1_source_ref,
        count(distinct n.cesc_entity_id) as r1_entity_count
    from nodes n
    inner join cih c
        on c.cih_source_row_key = n.primary_cih_source_row_key
    where c.r1_source_ref is not null
    group by c.r1_source_ref
),

-- lifetime rows are eligible only for an R1 that maps to exactly one entity; ambiguous R1s stay unmatched (NULL)
lifetime as (
    select * from (
        select
            l.r1_source_ref,
            l.first_bill_date,
            l.last_bill_date,
            l.tenure,
            l.bill_count,
            l.lifetime_spend,
            l.recency_days,
            row_number() over (
                partition by l.r1_source_ref
                order by l._loaded_at desc nulls last, l.last_bill_date desc nulls last
            ) as rn
        FROM "cdp_meta"."staging"."stg_cesc_lifetime" l
        where l.r1_source_ref in (select r1_source_ref from r1_map where r1_entity_count = 1)
    ) x
    where x.rn = 1
),

ranked as (
    select
        m.*,
        row_number() over (
            partition by m.cesc_entity_id
            order by m.month_start desc nulls last, m.bill_ac_month::text desc
        ) as month_rank,
        extract(year from max(m.month_start) over (partition by m.cesc_entity_id))::int as annual_year_anchor
    from "cdp_meta"."silver_gold"."cesc_customer_monthly" m
),

latest as (
    select * from ranked where month_rank = 1
),

agg as (
    select
        cesc_entity_id,
        count(*) filter (where month_start is not null)                          as billed_months_available,
        min(month_start)                                                         as first_billed_month,
        max(month_start)                                                         as latest_billed_month,
        
        
        count(total_unit) filter (where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 3)                                 as consumption_months_3m,
        
        avg(total_unit) filter (where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 3)                                   as avg_consumption_3m,
        
        
        
        count(total_unit) filter (where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 6)                                 as consumption_months_6m,
        
        avg(total_unit) filter (where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 6)                                   as avg_consumption_6m,
        
        
        
        count(total_unit) filter (where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 12)                                 as consumption_months_12m,
        
        avg(total_unit) filter (where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 12)                                   as avg_consumption_12m,
        
        
        -- contract: stddev(consumption) / mean(consumption); period not specified -> 12-month window
        -- (longest window the contract defines), sample standard deviation; needs >= 2 months
        stddev_samp(total_unit) filter (where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 12)
            / nullif(avg(total_unit) filter (where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 12), 0)                as consumption_volatility,
        
        cast(null as double precision)                                           as consumption_slope,
        cast(null as double precision)                                           as arrear_slope,
        cast(null as double precision)                                           as billing_slope,
        
        
        cast(null as numeric)                                                    as lifetime_bill_value,
        cast(null as numeric)                                                    as annual_billed_value,
        
        max(annual_year_anchor)                                                  as annual_year,
        count(*) filter (
            where month_start is not null
              and extract(year from month_start)::int = annual_year_anchor)      as annual_months_available,
        sum(total_unit) filter (
            where month_start is not null
              and extract(year from month_start)::int = annual_year_anchor)      as annual_consumption
    from ranked
    group by cesc_entity_id
),

pm_counts as (
    select cesc_entity_id, payment_method, count(*) as c
    from ranked
    where month_start is not null and month_rank <= 12 and payment_method is not null
    group by cesc_entity_id, payment_method
),

pm_ranked as (
    select
        cesc_entity_id,
        payment_method,
        rank() over (partition by cesc_entity_id order by c desc) as rk
    from pm_counts
),

pm_pref as (
    select
        cesc_entity_id,
        case when count(*) filter (where rk = 1) > 1 then 'MIXED'
             else max(payment_method) filter (where rk = 1) end    as preferred_payment_method
    from pm_ranked
    group by cesc_entity_id
)

select
    -- ══ identity / lineage: cesc_entity_id is the ONLY UNIFY360 identity key ══
    n.cesc_entity_id,
    n.entity_type,
    n.primary_cih_source_row_key,
    c.r1_source_ref,                                                 -- source reference only
    rm.r1_entity_count,                                              -- >1 = ambiguous R1: lifetime attributes NULL
    n.first_seen_at                                                  as entity_first_seen_at,
    n.last_updated_at                                                as entity_last_updated_at,

    -- ══ (B) primary / latest source-record attributes (one real bill; customer_id is a source ref, not a key) ══
    lm.customer_id,
    lm.consumer_no,
    lm.check_digit,
    lm.consumer_type,
    lm.consumer_status_code,
    lm.consumer_account_status,
    lm.public_body_status_code                                       as public_body_status,
    lm.regional_office,
    lm.supply_address,
    lm.address_line_two,                                             -- ADDRESS_LINE_ONE is the customer NAME, never an address line
    lm.address_line_three,
    lm.address_line_four,
    lm.address_line_five,
    lm.address_line_six,
    lm.road_code,
    lm.premises_no,
    lm.lamp_post_no,
    lm.supply_type,
    lm.supply_mode,
    lm.load_kw,                                                      -- single-record LOAD of the primary bill (not summed)
    lm.voltage_status,
    lm.tax_status,
    lm.bill_ac_month,
    lm.bill_date,
    lm.due_date,
    lm.subsidy_status,
    lm.advance_payment_status,
    lm.bill_type,
    lm.ebill_status,
    lm.avg_unit                                                      as average_consumption,   -- single-record AVG_UNIT (never summed)
    lm.payment_channel,
    lm.payment_method,
    lm.digital_payment_status,                                       -- NULL: ONLINE/OFFLINE/NOPMNT mapping not defined in available spec; raw values in payment_channel
    lm.consumption_deviation_pct                                     as consumption_deviation, -- primary bill's own TOTAL_UNIT vs AVG_UNIT

    -- (B/C) contact fields: canonical entity value first, then CIH, then latest bill (validated) as fallback
    coalesce(n.canonical_email, c.email_normalized, lm.email_id)     as email_id,
    coalesce(n.canonical_mobile, c.mobile_normalized, lm.mobile_number) as mobile_number,
    -- (B/C) pincode: contract source is bill PIN_CD; canonical / CIH values only as fallback
    coalesce(lm.pin_cd::text, n.canonical_pincode::text, c.pincode::text) as pincode,

    -- ══ (A) entity-month aggregates for the latest billing month (sum over all resolved bills that month) ══
    lm.bills_in_month                                                as latest_month_bills_count,
    lm.consumer_numbers_in_month                                     as latest_month_consumer_numbers,
    lm.net_amount,
    lm.gross_amount,
    lm.rebate_amount,
    lm.arrear_amount,
    lm.adjustment_amount,
    lm.govt_duty,
    lm.meter_rent_amount,
    lm.security_deposit_amount,
    lm.energy_charges_amount,
    lm.fixed_demand_charges,
    lm.monthly_variable_cost_adjustment,
    lm.fppas_amount,
    lm.advance_payment_adjustment,
    lm.total_unit                                                    as monthly_consumption,

    -- ══ (C) canonical / CIH attributes ══
    coalesce(c.name_normalized, n.canonical_name)                    as customer_name,
    c.city,
    c.house_no                                                       as cih_house_no,      -- CIH address structure differs from the
    c.floor                                                          as cih_floor,         -- bill's; kept separate, not merged
    c.street                                                         as cih_street,
    c.dnd_raw                                                        as dnd,
    c.is_mobile_normalized                                           as mobile_capable,

    -- ══ (D) lifetime attributes ══
    lf.first_bill_date,
    lf.last_bill_date,
    lf.tenure                                                        as tenure_days,
    lf.tenure::numeric / 30.0                                        as tenure_months,     -- contract: TENURE / 30 (approx.)
    lf.bill_count,
    lf.lifetime_spend,
    lf.recency_days,

    -- ══ (E) derived from the latest month's aggregates (like-with-like inputs) ══
    lm.outstanding_burden_ratio,
    lm.arrear_persistence_months,
    lm.arrear_recovery_rate,
    lm.effective_bill_cost_per_unit,
    lm.energy_charge_contribution_pct                                as energy_charge_contribution,

    -- ══ (E) derived from history ══
    a.avg_consumption_3m,
    a.avg_consumption_6m,
    a.avg_consumption_12m,
    a.consumption_months_3m,
    a.consumption_months_6m,
    a.consumption_months_12m,
    a.consumption_volatility,
    pp.preferred_payment_method,                                     -- most frequent payment method, 12-month window; tie => MIXED
    case when a.arrear_slope is null then null
         when abs(a.arrear_slope) <= 0 then 'STABLE'
         when a.arrear_slope > 0 then 'INCREASING'
         else 'DECREASING' end                                       as arrears_trend,         -- NULL unless trend vars configured
    case when a.consumption_slope is null then null
         when abs(a.consumption_slope) <= 0 then 'STABLE'
         when a.consumption_slope > 0 then 'INCREASING'
         else 'DECREASING' end                                       as consumption_trend,     -- NULL unless trend vars configured
    case when a.billing_slope is null then null
         when abs(a.billing_slope) <= 0 then 'STABLE'
         when a.billing_slope > 0 then 'INCREASING'
         else 'DECREASING' end                                       as billing_trend,         -- NULL unless trend vars configured
    
    cast(null as boolean)                                            as persistent_arrear_flag,
    
    a.lifetime_bill_value,                                           -- NULL until cesc_bill_value_approved_basis is set
    a.annual_billed_value,                                           -- NULL until cesc_bill_value_approved_basis is set
    a.annual_consumption,
    a.annual_year,
    'WORKING_DEFAULT_CALENDAR_YEAR_OF_LATEST_BILL_MONTH' as annual_year_source,
    a.annual_months_available,

    -- ══ (F) unsupported / unapproved: always NULL ══
    cast(null as text)    as district,
    cast(null as text)    as state,
    cast(null as text)    as load_category,
    cast(null as text)    as tariff_type,
    cast(null as text)    as meter_number,
    cast(null as text)    as meter_type,
    cast(null as text)    as added_load,
    cast(null as text)    as theft_tag,
    cast(null as text)    as tenure_bucket,
    cast(null as numeric) as advance_payment_amount,
    cast(null as text)    as consumption_bucket,
    cast(null as text)    as consumption_slab,
    cast(null as text)    as seasonal_consumption_profile,
    cast(null as text)    as payment_method_stability,               -- no stable/variable rule or period in the contract
    cast(null as text)    as payment_channel_migration,
    cast(null as numeric) as monthly_payment_fulfilment_rate,
    cast(null as numeric) as on_time_payment_score,
    cast(null as numeric) as payment_consistency_score,
    cast(null as text)    as payment_behaviour_profile,
    cast(null as text)    as arrear_status,
    cast(null as text)    as consumption_anomaly_status,
    cast(null as text)    as bill_shock_status,
    cast(null as numeric) as annual_payment_fulfilment_rate,
    cast(null as text)    as app_status,
    cast(null as text)    as app_payment_status,
    cast(null as text)    as digital_engagement_status,
    cast(null as text)    as current_payment_status,
    cast(null as text)    as complaint_status,
    cast(null as text)    as complaint_behaviour,
    cast(null as text)    as service_behaviour,
    cast(null as text)    as digital_friction_status,
    cast(null as text)    as service_dependency,
    cast(null as text)    as customer_effort_status,
    cast(null as text)    as repeat_issue_status,
    cast(null as text)    as service_resolution_status,
    cast(null as text)    as digital_adoption_gap,
    cast(null as text)    as digital_self_service_status,
    cast(null as text)    as digital_migration_status,
    cast(null as text)    as device_type,
    cast(null as text)    as screen_resolution,
    cast(null as text)    as digital_language,
    cast(null as text)    as device_manufacturer,
    cast(null as date)    as app_installed_date,
    cast(null as text)    as app_version,
    cast(null as text)    as operating_system,
    cast(null as text)    as os_version,
    cast(null as text)    as browser,
    cast(null as text)    as most_active_channel,
    cast(null as text)    as most_active_time,
    cast(null as text)    as most_active_day,

    -- ══ history coverage / lineage ══
    a.billed_months_available,
    a.first_billed_month,
    a.latest_billed_month,
    current_timestamp                                                as gold_built_at
from nodes n
left join cih c
    on c.cih_source_row_key = n.primary_cih_source_row_key
left join r1_map rm
    on rm.r1_source_ref = c.r1_source_ref
left join lifetime lf
    on lf.r1_source_ref = c.r1_source_ref
left join agg a
    on a.cesc_entity_id = n.cesc_entity_id
left join latest lm
    on lm.cesc_entity_id = n.cesc_entity_id
left join pm_pref pp
    on pp.cesc_entity_id = n.cesc_entity_id

analysis.cesc_identity.cesc_gold_validat.name: cesc_gold_validation
analysis.cesc_identity.cesc_gold_validat.raw_code:
-- CESC Gold validation for psql. Queries only the Gold tables in schema silver_gold.
-- Checks that need the identity tables (entity coverage, RESOLVED-bill reconciliation) are enforced in dbt with
-- ref(): tests/assert_cesc_customer_360_coverage.sql  (run: dbt test --select cesc_customer_360)
-- Bill -> entity integrity (a resolved bill linked to >1 cesc_entity_id) needs the identity edges and is enforced in
-- dbt: tests/assert_cesc_bill_single_entity.sql. Such bills are EXCLUDED from Gold, never assigned to one entity.
-- R1 ambiguity is enforced in dbt (tests/assert_cesc_r1_single_entity.sql) and mirrored below (14, 15) from Gold.

-- 1. 360 grain: expect 0 rows
select cesc_entity_id, count(*) as n
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360
group by cesc_entity_id
having count(*) > 1;

-- 2. monthly grain: expect 0 rows
select cesc_entity_id, bill_ac_month, count(*) as n
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_monthly
group by cesc_entity_id, bill_ac_month
having count(*) > 1;

-- 3. each primary bill lands in exactly one entity-month row: expect 0 rows
select primary_bill_source_key, count(*) as n
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_monthly
group by primary_bill_source_key
having count(*) > 1;

-- 4. row counts
select (select count(*) from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360)                            as rows_360,
       (select count(*) from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360 where billed_months_available is null) as entities_without_bills,
       (select count(distinct cesc_entity_id) from silver_gold.cesc_customer_monthly)   as entities_with_bills,
       (select count(*) from silver_gold.cesc_customer_monthly)                         as rows_monthly,
       (select sum(bills_in_month) from silver_gold.cesc_customer_monthly)              as bills_combined_into_monthly;

-- 5. entity-months that combine more than one bill (where (A) sums differ from a single source record)
select bills_in_month, count(*) as entity_months
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_monthly
group by bills_in_month
order by bills_in_month;

-- 6. months of history per entity (drives how many 3M/6M/12M values are full windows)
select billed_months_available, count(*) as entities
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360
group by billed_months_available
order by billed_months_available;

-- 7. full vs partial windows
select count(*) filter (where consumption_months_3m  = 3)  as full_3m,
       count(*) filter (where consumption_months_6m  = 6)  as full_6m,
       count(*) filter (where consumption_months_12m = 12) as full_12m,
       count(*) filter (where avg_consumption_12m is not null and consumption_months_12m < 12) as partial_12m
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360;

-- 8. no hard-coded month: recompute each entity's 3M average independently from the monthly table
--    using its own latest 3 months; expect 0 rows
with ranked as (
    select cesc_entity_id, total_unit,
           row_number() over (partition by cesc_entity_id order by month_start desc) as rn
    from silver_gold.cesc_customer_monthly
    where month_start is not null
),
recomputed as (
    select cesc_entity_id, avg(total_unit) as avg_3m, count(total_unit) as n
    from ranked where rn <= 3 group by cesc_entity_id
)
select c.cesc_entity_id, c.avg_consumption_3m, r.avg_3m
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360 c
join recomputed r using (cesc_entity_id)
where c.avg_consumption_3m is distinct from r.avg_3m
   or c.consumption_months_3m is distinct from r.n;

-- 9. no hard-coded month: distribution of each entity's latest billed month
select latest_billed_month, count(*) as entities
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360
group by latest_billed_month
order by latest_billed_month desc
limit 12;

-- 10. AVG_UNIT and LOAD are single-record values: no monthly row may carry them from a summed source
--     (spot check: multi-bill months still hold one avg_unit / load_kw value; list a sample)
select cesc_entity_id, bill_ac_month, bills_in_month, total_unit, primary_bill_total_unit, avg_unit, load_kw
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_monthly
where bills_in_month > 1
limit 20;

-- 11. unsupported attributes must be entirely NULL: expect 0
select count(*) as populated_unsupported_rows
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360
where digital_payment_status is not null or district is not null or state is not null or load_category is not null or tariff_type is not null
   or meter_number is not null or meter_type is not null or added_load is not null or theft_tag is not null
   or tenure_bucket is not null or advance_payment_amount is not null or consumption_bucket is not null
   or consumption_slab is not null or seasonal_consumption_profile is not null
   or payment_method_stability is not null or payment_channel_migration is not null
   or monthly_payment_fulfilment_rate is not null or on_time_payment_score is not null
   or payment_consistency_score is not null or payment_behaviour_profile is not null
   or arrear_status is not null or consumption_anomaly_status is not null or bill_shock_status is not null
   or annual_payment_fulfilment_rate is not null
   or app_status is not null or app_payment_status is not null or digital_engagement_status is not null
   or current_payment_status is not null or complaint_status is not null or complaint_behaviour is not null
   or service_behaviour is not null or digital_friction_status is not null or service_dependency is not null
   or customer_effort_status is not null or repeat_issue_status is not null or service_resolution_status is not null
   or digital_adoption_gap is not null or digital_self_service_status is not null or digital_migration_status is not null
   or device_type is not null or screen_resolution is not null or digital_language is not null
   or device_manufacturer is not null or app_installed_date is not null or app_version is not null
   or operating_system is not null or os_version is not null or browser is not null
   or most_active_channel is not null or most_active_time is not null or most_active_day is not null;

-- 12. config-gated columns: all NULL unless their var is set (approved basis, persistence N, trend window + tolerance)
select count(lifetime_bill_value)     as lifetime_bill_value_populated,
       count(annual_billed_value)     as annual_billed_value_populated,
       count(persistent_arrear_flag)  as persistent_arrear_flag_populated,
       count(arrears_trend)           as arrears_trend_populated,
       count(consumption_trend)       as consumption_trend_populated,
       count(billing_trend)           as billing_trend_populated
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360;

-- 13. annual year provenance
select annual_year_source, annual_year, count(*) as entities
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360
group by annual_year_source, annual_year
order by annual_year desc nulls last;

-- 14. R1 ambiguity (informational): source references shared by more than one cesc_entity_id.
--     These are NOT collapsed; the entities stay separate and their lifetime attributes are NULL.
select r1_source_ref, count(distinct cesc_entity_id) as entities
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360
where r1_source_ref is not null
group by r1_source_ref
having count(distinct cesc_entity_id) > 1
order by entities desc, r1_source_ref
limit 50;

-- 15. ambiguous R1 must never carry lifetime attributes: expect 0
select count(*) as ambiguous_r1_with_lifetime
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360
where r1_entity_count > 1
  and (first_bill_date is not null or last_bill_date is not null or tenure_days is not null
       or tenure_months is not null or bill_count is not null or lifetime_spend is not null
       or recency_days is not null);

-- 16. raw payment channel is preserved; digital_payment_status is NULL for every row (mapping not in spec)
select payment_channel, count(*) as entities, count(digital_payment_status) as digital_payment_status_populated
from silver_gold.cesc_customer_360
group by payment_channel
order by entities desc;

test.cesc_identity.assert_cesc_bill_sing.name: assert_cesc_bill_single_entity
test.cesc_identity.assert_cesc_bill_sing.raw_code:
-- Identity-integrity check (error). Fails (returns rows) for every RESOLVED bill observation that is linked to
-- MORE THAN ONE existing cesc_entity_id by an OBSERVED_ON_BILL edge.
-- Gold does not pick an entity for such a bill: cesc_customer_monthly excludes it. The fix belongs in identity
-- resolution, not in Gold. Set severity to 'warn' here if the team wants the build to continue while it is triaged.
with resolved as (
    select distinct bill_source_key::text as k
    from {{ ref('cesc_identity_resolution') }}
    where resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'
)
select 'bill_linked_to_multiple_entities' as issue,
       e.to_node_id::text                 as bill_source_key,
       count(distinct en.cesc_entity_id::text) as entity_count
from {{ ref('cesc_identity_edges') }} e
inner join resolved r  on r.k = e.to_node_id::text
inner join {{ ref('cesc_entity_nodes') }} en on en.cesc_entity_id::text = e.from_node_id::text
where e.from_node_type = 'CESC_ENTITY'
  and e.to_node_type   = 'BILL_OBSERVATION'
  and e.edge_type      = 'OBSERVED_ON_BILL'
group by e.to_node_id::text
having count(distinct en.cesc_entity_id::text) > 1

test.cesc_identity.assert_cesc_customer_.name: assert_cesc_customer_360_coverage
test.cesc_identity.assert_cesc_customer_.raw_code:
-- Fails (returns rows) on any of:
--   * 360 does not contain exactly the entities of cesc_entity_nodes (coverage is by cesc_entity_id only)
--   * monthly contains an entity that is not in 360
--   * a monthly primary bill is not RESOLVED in cesc_identity_resolution
--   * the number of bills combined into cesc_customer_monthly differs from the number of bills that are
--     RESOLVED, linked to EXACTLY ONE existing entity by an OBSERVED_ON_BILL edge, and present in stg_cesc_bill
--     (bills linked to several entities are excluded from Gold and reported by assert_cesc_bill_single_entity)
--   * an entity whose R1 is shared with another entity carries lifetime attributes (must be NULL)
with n as (select cesc_entity_id::text as id from {{ ref('cesc_entity_nodes') }}),
g as (select cesc_entity_id::text as id from {{ ref('cesc_customer_360') }}),
m as (select distinct cesc_entity_id::text as id from {{ ref('cesc_customer_monthly') }}),

resolved as (
    select distinct bill_source_key::text as k
    from {{ ref('cesc_identity_resolution') }}
    where resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'
),
linked as (
    select e.to_node_id::text as k
    from {{ ref('cesc_identity_edges') }} e
    inner join resolved r on r.k = e.to_node_id::text

{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    pre_hook="
        INSERT INTO cesc_silver.cesc_entity_id_registry (cih_source_row_key, last_seen_run_id)
        SELECT DISTINCT cih_source_row_key, '{{ var('run_id') }}'
        FROM {{ source('staging', 'stg_cesc_cih') }}
        WHERE cih_source_row_key IS NOT NULL
        ON CONFLICT (cih_source_row_key) DO UPDATE
        SET last_seen_run_id = EXCLUDED.last_seen_run_id;
    ",
    indexes=[
        {'columns': ['cesc_entity_id'], 'unique': true},
        {'columns': ['primary_cih_source_row_key']},
        {'columns': ['entity_type']}
    ]
) }}

WITH cih_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cih_source_row_key
    FROM {{ source('staging', 'stg_cesc_cih') }}
    WHERE cih_source_row_key IS NOT NULL
),

cih_profiles AS (
    SELECT
        cih_source_row_key,
        name_normalized AS canonical_name,
        mobile_normalized AS canonical_mobile,
        email_normalized AS canonical_email,
        pincode AS canonical_pincode,
        _loaded_at AS first_seen_at
    FROM {{ source('staging', 'stg_cesc_cih') }}
),

cih_entities AS (
    SELECT
        k.cih_source_row_key,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM {{ ref('cesc_identity_resolution') }} r
            WHERE r.resolved_cih_source_row_key = k.cih_source_row_key
              AND r.resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'
        ) AS has_resolved_bill
    FROM cih_keys k
),

cih_nodes AS (
    SELECT
        reg.cesc_entity_id,
        re.cih_source_row_key AS primary_cih_source_row_key,
        CASE
            WHEN re.has_resolved_bill THEN 'RESOLVED_CIH'
            ELSE 'CIH_PROFILE'
        END AS entity_type,
        p.canonical_name,
        p.canonical_mobile,
        p.canonical_email,
        p.canonical_pincode,
        p.first_seen_at,
        CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS last_updated_at,
        'CESC' AS source_system,
        '{{ var("run_id") }}' AS run_id
    FROM cih_entities re
    JOIN cesc_silver.cesc_entity_id_registry reg
        ON re.cih_source_row_key = reg.cih_source_row_key
    JOIN cih_profiles p
        ON re.cih_source_row_key = p.cih_source_row_key
),

bill_only_nodes AS (
    SELECT
        m.cesc_entity_id,
        NULL::TEXT AS primary_cih_source_row_key,
        'BILL_ONLY' AS entity_type,
        NULL::TEXT AS canonical_name,
        CASE
            WHEN m.identity_key_type = 'PHONE'
            THEN m.identity_key_value
            ELSE NULL
        END AS canonical_mobile,
        NULL::TEXT AS canonical_email,
        NULL::TEXT AS canonical_pincode,
        NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS first_seen_at,
        CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS last_updated_at,
        'CESC' AS source_system,
        '{{ var("run_id") }}' AS run_id
    FROM cesc_silver.cesc_bill_only_consumer_map m
)

UNION ALL

        'DETERMINISTIC' AS score_type,
        '{{ var("run_id") }}' AS run_id,
        CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at
    FROM entities
    WHERE canonical_mobile IS NOT NULL

-- Edge 3: CESC_ENTITY -> EMAIL (canonical)

        'DETERMINISTIC' AS score_type,
        '{{ var("run_id") }}' AS run_id,
        CLOCK_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at
    FROM entities
    WHERE canonical_email IS NOT NULL

-- Edge 4: CESC_ENTITY -> CONSUMER_NUMBER (historical)
e_entity_consumer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        'CESC_ENTITY' AS from_node_type,
        e.cesc_entity_id::TEXT AS from_node_id,
        'CONSUMER_NUMBER' AS to_node_type,
        cc.consumer_no AS to_node_id,
        'HAS_CONSUMER' AS edge_type,
        'DETERMINISTIC' AS resolution_method,
        100.00 AS confidence_score,
        'DETERMINISTIC' AS score_type,
        '{{ var("run_id") }}' AS run_id,

    FROM entities e
    JOIN cih_consumers cc ON e.primary_cih_source_row_key = cc.cih_source_row_key

-- Edge 5: CESC_ENTITY -> BILL_OBSERVATION (resolved bills)
e_entity_bill AS (
    SELECT
        'CESC_ENTITY' AS from_node_type,
        cesc_entity_id::TEXT AS from_node_id,
        'BILL_OBSERVATION' AS to_node_type,
        bill_source_key AS to_node_id,

model.cesc_identity.cesc_customer_monthl.description: CESC Gold customer-month foundation. Grain: exactly one row per cesc_entity_id x bill_ac_month (enforced by tests/assert_cesc_customer_monthly_grain.sql and a unique index). Built from stg_cesc_bill (full history; cesc_bill_spine is not used) joined to RESOLVED identity mappings. A bill enters only if it maps to exactly one existing cesc_entity_id; bills linked to several entities are excluded and reported by tests/assert_cesc_bill_single_entity.sql. When an entity has several bills in a month: additive amounts and total_unit are SUMMED (entity-month aggregates); every other source attribute, including avg_unit and load_kw, is copied from ONE primary bill (latest bill_date, then largest net_amount, then bill_source_key). No payment-transaction metrics exist here.
